intent: A dark account settings page with scroll-spy section nav, custom switches and segmented controls, an avatar uploader, a typed-confirm danger zone and a sticky bar that counts unsaved changes.

stack.fonts: font-display (Geist, tight tracking), font-sans (Geist), font-mono (Geist Mono)

layout.header: mono breadcrumb, display heading, one-line description (max 68ch)
layout.desktop: 180px sticky section nav + content column, 56px gap
layout.mobile: nav becomes a sticky horizontal scrolling tab strip
sections: Profile: avatar, display name, username with prefix, bio with counter, pronouns, time zone
Appearance: theme + density segmented, week start select
Danger zone: export, delete with typed confirmation
layout.rows: label + hint left, control right (2fr/3fr) at ≥768px; switches always right-aligned
layout.saveBar: sticky bottom of the content column, max 560px, count + Discard + Save ⌘S

motion.pills: shared layoutId springs for nav and segmented controls
motion.saveBar: y 96 → 0 spring (380/34); message cross-fade unsaved ↔ saved
motion.reducedMotion: fades only; no springs; no ping
motion.press: buttons and links press to 0.97, full-width rows to 0.99, 150ms; one shared transition for colour and transform

responsive.390: tab strip nav; rows stack; segmented controls full width; danger buttons below their text

accessibility: switches are role=switch with aria-checked and a 44px hit area
segmented controls are radiogroups with roving tabindex and arrow keys
real labels and native selects; bio counter linked with aria-describedby

content.bio: Field researcher. I collect interview notes, bad puns and good coffee.
hints: Monday morning: what changed in notes you follow.
New features, about once a month. No “we miss you”.
Compact fits about 30% more notes on screen.
content.danger: Type your username to confirm; afterwards: a last-chance link is emailed, account goes in 48 hours
